title: Greater Vancouver Regional District Air Quality Management Bylaw No. 1082, 2008 (Unofficial Consolidation)

values.quote: Air Quality Management Bylaw No. 1082, 2008
Subject to section 10, nothing in section 5 or 6 prohibits the discharge of an air contaminant where
less than 5 kilograms per day of each of the following: nitrogen oxides (expressed as nitrogen dioxide); and sulphur oxides
the discharge is from steam powered or internal combustion engines in compliance, if applicable, with the Motor Vehicle Act

unsupported_wording: none. The 7(12) exemption also needs CO under 100 kg/day and SOx under 5 kg/day, and is subject to s.10.
note: The 7(9) wording ties engines to Motor Vehicle Act compliance 'if applicable'. Whether that covers stationary generators is not stated, which fits 'applicability unsettled'. This is an unofficial consolidation.
